advisories.title: SonicOS affected by multiple vulnerabilities (auth bypass, path traversal, DoS)
advisories.summary: Improper access control (CVE-2026-0204, CVSS 8.0, CWE-1390/306) may allow an unauthenticated attacker on an adjacent network to reach management-interface functions without authentication; combined with a post-auth path traversal (CVE-2026-0205, CVSS 6.8) and a post-auth stack-based buffer overflow DoS (CVE-2026-0206). Affects Gen6/Gen7/Gen8.

advisories.title: SonicOS SSLVPN Pre-Auth Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: A pre-authentication stack-based buffer overflow (CWE-121) in the SonicOS SSLVPN service lets a remote unauthenticated attacker crash the firewall, causing denial of service. Only devices with the SSLVPN interface/service enabled are exposed.

advisories.title: SonicOS multiple post-authentication vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: A set of post-authentication vulnerabilities in SonicOS that require valid credentials to exploit; aggregate maximum CVSS 4.9 (Medium).

latest_known_firmware.note: SonicOS 7.3.1-7013 was the maintenance release adding Credential Auditor; confirm the current build on the SonicWall download portal.
